key: A stack of job applications for the Central Salon sits on the table.
en: A stack of job applications for the Central Salon sits on the table.
ja: テーブルに　中央美容室の　求人応募用紙が　積まれている

key: Take one?
en: Take one?
ja: 1枚　取りますか?

key: If you have more happy Pokémon, I'd love to see them even though I don't have anything more for you.
en: If you have more happy Pokémon, I'd love to see them even though I don't have anything more for you.
ja: 他にも　幸せなポケモンがいるなら　見せてほしい。もう　渡せる物はないがな

key: That kind of thing is always a nice reminder for me.
en: That kind of thing is always a nice reminder for me.
ja: ああいう姿は　いつも　大事なことを　思い出させてくれる

key: Trainers these days don't seem to put the proper care into raising their Pokémon.
en: Trainers these days don't seem to put the proper care into raising their Pokémon.
ja: 最近のトレーナーは　ポケモンを　ちゃんと大事に育てていないようだ

key: You're no different, are you?
en: You're no different, are you?
ja: お前も　同じだろう?

key: If you have a Pokémon that's truly happy with you, I'd like to see it. I won't believe a thing until then.
en: If you have a Pokémon that's truly happy with you, I'd like to see it. I won't believe a thing until then.
ja: 本当に　なついているポケモンがいるなら　見せてみろ。それまでは　何も信じん

key: Hm? Well, another time perhaps?
en: Hm? Well, another time perhaps?
ja: ん? まあ　またの機会にな

key: Hmmm...
en: Hmmm...
ja: ふむ……

key: As expected from you.
en: As expected from you.
ja: さすがだな

key: Keep taking good care of your Pokémon, and showing others how to do the same.
en: Keep taking good care of your Pokémon, and showing others how to do the same.
ja: これからも　ポケモンを大事にして　その姿を　他の者にも見せてやれ

key: Fine.
en: Fine.
ja: いいだろう

key: I can see this Pokémon truly respects you. I won't let my cynicism disparage that.
en: I can see this Pokémon truly respects you. I won't let my cynicism disparage that.
ja: このポケモンが　心から　お前を慕っているのが分かる。オレのひねくれ根性で　けなすつもりはない

key: It's encouraging that at least some Trainers out there still know how to treat their Pokémon.
en: It's encouraging that at least some Trainers out there still know how to treat their Pokémon.
ja: ポケモンの扱い方を　まだ分かっているトレーナーもいる。それは　救いだ

key: I'd like you to take this.
en: I'd like you to take this.
ja: これを　受け取ってくれ

key: Please continue to love your Pokémon, and encourage others to do the same.
en: Please continue to love your Pokémon, and encourage others to do the same.
ja: これからも　ポケモンを愛して　他の者にも　そうするよう　すすめてやってくれ

key: That would be very important to me.
en: That would be very important to me.
ja: それが　オレにとって　とても大事なことなんだ

key: You call this 'happy'? If that's really how you think, you're lucky it puts up with you.
en: You call this 'happy'? If that's really how you think, you're lucky it puts up with you.
ja: これで　なついていると? 本気でそう思っているなら　よく我慢してもらえているものだな

key: Wait.
en: Wait.
ja: 待って

key: This is one of that other gaudy salon's Glameow, isn't it?
en: This is one of that other gaudy salon's Glameow, isn't it?
ja: それって　あの派手な美容室の　ニャルマーじゃない?

key: Now that I think of it, that's a pretty respectable marketing strategy.
en: Now that I think of it, that's a pretty respectable marketing strategy.
ja: 考えてみれば　宣伝のやり方としては　なかなか大したものね

key: Anytime someone sees a Glameow, they'd think of that place, right?
en: Anytime someone sees a Glameow, they'd think of that place, right?
ja: ニャルマーを見るたびに　あの店を思い出すってわけ

key: All right, time to do one better.
en: All right, time to do one better.
ja: よし　こっちは　その上を行くわ

key: I've got a Pokémon that'll really kick off our image.
en: I've got a Pokémon that'll really kick off our image.
ja: うちのイメージを　一気に押し上げてくれるポケモンがいるの

key: Say, why don't you battle it so I can take some footage of it in action?
en: Say, why don't you battle it so I can take some footage of it in action?
ja: ねえ　戦ってくれない? 活躍しているところを　撮りたいの

key: Well, I was really hoping for a win there, but...
en: Well, I was really hoping for a win there, but...
ja: うーん　勝ちたかったんだけど……

key: SUZY: Not the best performance, but it's a good first step.
en: SUZY: Not the best performance, but it's a good first step.
ja: スージー: 最高の出来じゃないけど　第一歩としては　悪くないわ

key: We'll make Tsareena the star of the Central Salon!
en: We'll make Tsareena the star of the Central Salon!
ja: アマージョを　中央美容室の　看板にするの!

key: ...Just as soon as I clear it with my boss.
en: ...Just as soon as I clear it with my boss.
ja: ……店長の　許可が取れたらね

key: Anyway, thanks for the inspiration.
en: Anyway, thanks for the inspiration.
ja: とにかく　ひらめきをくれて　ありがとう

key: Why don't you go ahead and take this one?
en: Why don't you go ahead and take this one?
ja: これ　持っていって

key: SUZY: You know who to think of when you see it!
en: SUZY: You know who to think of when you see it!
ja: スージー: これを見たら　誰を思い出すか　分かるわよね!

key: Welcome to the Obsidia Salon!
en: Welcome to the Obsidia Salon!
ja: オブシディア美容室へ　ようこそ!

key: How may we service you?
en: How may we service you?
ja: ご用件を　うかがいます

key: Oh! We're also now accepting new hires.
en: Oh! We're also now accepting new hires.
ja: あっ! 今　新しい人も　募集しています

key: If you have experience in the field and are interested, please take an application from the table over there!
en: If you have experience in the field and are interested, please take an application from the table over there!
ja: 経験があって　興味があれば　あちらのテーブルから　応募用紙を　どうぞ!

key: Miss Voclain is one of our premier customers here!
en: Miss Voclain is one of our premier customers here!
ja: ヴォクレイン様は　当店の　特別なお客様なんです!

key: As a former star model herself, she's done no small amount of work to help legitimize us as an anchor business.
en: As a former star model herself, she's done no small amount of work to help legitimize us as an anchor business.
ja: 元トップモデルとして　この店を　街の看板店として認めさせるのに　力を貸してくださいました

key: Hello!
en: Hello!
ja: こんにちは!

key: Can I interest you in the Central Obsidia Salon's patented professional grooming procedure?
en: Can I interest you in the Central Obsidia Salon's patented professional grooming procedure?
ja: 中央オブシディア美容室　自慢の　プロのお手入れは　いかがですか?

key: We can groom your Pokémon once a day for $1500. Does that sound good, or does that sound great?
en: We can groom your Pokémon once a day for $1500.  Does that sound good, or does that sound great?
ja: 1日1回　$1500で　ポケモンをお手入れします。お得でしょう? いえ　最高でしょう?

key: No need to be shy!
en: No need to be shy!
ja: 遠慮は　いりませんよ!

key: All right! We'll just be a moment!
en: All right! We'll just be a moment!
ja: かしこまりました! 少々　お待ちください!

key: Okay! Here it is, cute as can be!
en: Okay! Here it is, cute as can be!
ja: はい! この通り　とってもかわいく!

key: Thank you, and until next time~
en: Thank you, and until next time~
ja: ありがとうございました　またのお越しを～

key: Hm? You don't have the money!
en: Hm? You don't have the money!
ja: あら? お金が　足りませんね!

key: No? Come on, I'm sure your Pokémon would love it!
en: No? Come on, I'm sure your Pokémon would love it!
ja: だめですか? きっと　ポケモンも　喜びますよ!

key: Please do come back again tomorrow. I'd love to give a little touch-up!
en: Please do come back again tomorrow. I'd love to give a little touch-up!
ja: また明日も　ぜひどうぞ。少し手直しさせてくださいね!

key: Hello! I can judge the happiness of Pokémon. May I see how your partners are doing?
en: Hello! I can judge the happiness of Pokémon. May I see how your partners are doing?
ja: こんにちは! わたしは　ポケモンのなつき度が　分かるんです。あなたの相棒を　見せてもらえますか?

key: Oh, wow. This is marvelous. It feels like the bond between you two is unbreakable!
en: Oh, wow. This is marvelous. It feels like the bond between you two is unbreakable!
ja: まあ　すばらしい。二人の結びつきは　もう　断ち切れないみたい!

key: It really seems to trust you. You've done a great job raising it! I can't wait to see how it grows!
en: It really seems to trust you. You've done a great job raising it! I can't wait to see how it grows!
ja: あなたを　本当に信頼していますね。よく育てています! これからが　楽しみです!

key: It seems like it's just starting to get comfortable with you. Definitely keep working with it!
en: It seems like it's just starting to get comfortable with you. Definitely keep working with it!
ja: あなたに　なれ始めたところみたい。これからも　一緒にがんばって!

key: Hm... I think you need to spend some more time with this one. If you do, I'm sure it'll become a great partner!
en: Hm... I think you need to spend some more time with this one. If you do, I'm sure it'll become a great partner!
ja: うーん……　この子とは　もっと時間を過ごした方がいいですね。そうすれば　きっと　いい相棒になりますよ!

key: This Pokémon feels like it's lost... Take good care of it, okay?
en: This Pokémon feels like it's lost... Take good care of it, okay?
ja: このポケモン　とまどっているみたい……　大事にしてあげてくださいね?

key: Hm? It seems scared. Did something happen?
en: Hm? It seems scared. Did something happen?
ja: あら? おびえていますね。何かありました?

key: This poor thing... It feels so scared and alone. Please treat it nicely!
en: This poor thing... It feels so scared and alone. Please treat it nicely!
ja: かわいそうに……　おびえて　ひとりぼっちみたい。やさしくしてあげて!

key: CLERK: Welcome back, Miss Serra Voclain!
en: CLERK: Welcome back, Miss Serra Voclain!
ja: 店員: セラ・ヴォクレイン様　お帰りなさいませ!

key: We've just gotten your latest shipment up this morning.
en: We've just gotten your latest shipment up this morning.
ja: 今朝　最新の入荷分を　並べたところです

key: A few of our regulars were already all over it!
en: A few of our regulars were already all over it!
ja: 常連のお客様が　もう　飛びついていましたよ!

key: SERRA: Oh, right.
en: SERRA: Oh, right.
ja: セラ: ああ　そうね

key: I suppose that was today, wasn't it?
en: I suppose that was today, wasn't it?
ja: それ　今日だったかしら

key: CLERK: You've still got a lot of loyals out there eager to pick up the endorsement!
en: CLERK: You've still got a lot of loyals out there eager to pick up the endorsement!
ja: 店員: 今でも　推薦品を求める　熱心なファンが　たくさんいらっしゃいます!

key: We're flattered that you've chosen us to feature you.
en: We're flattered that you've chosen us to feature you.
ja: 当店を　選んでいただけて　光栄です

key: SERRA: Nice of them to stick around for the slow decline.
en: SERRA: Nice of them to stick around for the slow decline.
ja: セラ: 落ちぶれていくのに　付き合ってくれるなんて　ご苦労なこと

key: I was just here to pick up the usual.
en: I was just here to pick up the usual.
ja: いつものを　取りに来ただけよ

key: CLERK: Of course; we've got it all ready for you.
en: CLERK: Of course; we've got it all ready for you.
ja: 店員: もちろんです　ご用意してあります

key: Just one second, please.
en: Just one second, please.
ja: 少々　お待ちください

key: SERRA: New regular?
en: SERRA: New regular?
ja: セラ: 新しい常連?

key: CLERK: Hm?
en: CLERK: Hm?
ja: 店員: え?

key: Oh, they're just a first-timer.
en: Oh, they're just a first-timer.
ja: いえ　初めてのお客様です

key: But you never know what could be the first of many!
en: But you never know what could be the first of many!
ja: でも　これが　始まりになるかも　しれませんよ!

key: SERRA: Or the last.
en: SERRA: Or the last.
ja: セラ: 最後になるかもね

key: It's a standard look, but standards are set for a reason.
en: It's a standard look, but standards are set for a reason.
ja: ありきたりな格好。でも　定番には　定番の理由があるわ

key: Black and white is bread and butter; building blocks which need a centerpiece.
en: Black and white is bread and butter; building blocks which need a centerpiece.
ja: 白と黒は　基本中の基本。土台にすぎない　中心になる一点が　いるわね

key: Thank the stars you're blonde.
en: Thank the stars you're blonde.
ja: 金髪で　助かったわね

key: All white is a bold choice.
en: All white is a bold choice.
ja: 全身白は　大胆な選択ね

key: The sunglasses tie the look together though.
en: The sunglasses tie the look together though.
ja: でも　サングラスが　全体を　まとめている

key: You're right to keep them on even indoors, no matter what anyone says.
en: You're right to keep them on even indoors, no matter what anyone says.
ja: 室内でも　外さないのは　正解よ。誰に何を言われてもね

key: Wild hair and a tight outfit.
en: Wild hair and a tight outfit.
ja: はねた髪に　体の線が出る服

key: You'd fit right in at my Gym with a look like that.
en: You'd fit right in at my Gym with a look like that.
ja: その格好なら　わたくしのジムでも　浮かないわね

key: Maybe pay us a visit sometime.
en: Maybe pay us a visit sometime.
ja: そのうち　顔を出しにいらっしゃい

key: Rough fashion, but I suppose some are into that.
en: Rough fashion, but I suppose some are into that.
ja: 荒っぽい格好。でも　好きな人も　いるでしょうね

key: The shirt pattern is nice at least.
en: The shirt pattern is nice at least.
ja: シャツの柄は　悪くないわ

key: And guard that earring with your life.
en: And guard that earring with your life.
ja: そのイヤリングは　命がけで守りなさい

key: Beautiful coat.
en: Beautiful coat.
ja: きれいなコートね

key: Its asymmetry is an ideal counterbalance to your side pony.
en: Its asymmetry is an ideal counterbalance to your side pony.
ja: 左右がそろっていないのが　サイドポニーと　ちょうどつり合っている

key: Keep rocking the accent splash; you're doing great.
en: Keep rocking the accent splash; you're doing great.
ja: その差し色は　そのまま続けなさい。よく分かっているわ

key: I'll never understand inner city fashion.
en: I'll never understand inner city fashion.
ja: 街なかの流行は　永遠に　理解できないわ

key: At least the fingerless gloves tie the look together.
en: At least the fingerless gloves tie the look together.
ja: せめて　指なし手ぶくろが　全体をまとめている

key: Those should definitely come back.
en: Those should definitely come back.
ja: あれは　絶対　また流行るべきね

key: CLERK: Here you are!
en: CLERK: Here you are!
ja: 店員: どうぞ　こちらです!

key: SERRA: Appreciated.
en: SERRA: Appreciated.
ja: セラ: 助かるわ

key: Until next time, then.
en: Until next time, then.
ja: では　また今度

key: Don't forget to call me when you find the cure to aging.
en: Don't forget to call me when you find the cure to aging.
ja: 老いを止める薬を見つけたら　わたくしに　連絡するのを　忘れないで

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
